durability.appendPersistence: every append flushes its data and metadata pages to the device, flushes both directories and writes the recovery checkpoint before LastEntryIndex is published (WriteAheadLog.PersistAppendAsync)
durability.acknowledgment: RaftCluster.ReplicateAsync returns after the entry is appended durably on the leader, replicated to a majority (a follower replies only after its own durable append), committed and applied on the leader
